name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
summary: A single-leg calf raise with a dumbbell, done on a step to work through a full range. It needs only a dumbbell and a step and trains each calf separately.
setup: Stand on a step or platform with the ball of one foot on the edge and the heel hanging off.
Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as the working leg.
Hold on to a wall or rail with the other hand for balance.
Cross the other foot behind or let it hang.
execution: Lower your heel slowly below the step until you feel a calf stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs.
mistakes: Rushing and bouncing: slow down and pause at the bottom.
Cutting the range short: use the full range.
Losing balance: hold a rail for support.
Rolling the ankle outward: keep the ball of the foot centered.
